summary: Completed comprehensive testing of WhatsApp integration feature. Backend: All 16 API endpoints tested and working correctly including upload, AI processing (real Gemini calls), approve/reject, contacts CRUD, and permissions. Frontend: All critical UI elements present and functional including admin-only sidebar link, upload dialog, filters, tabs, contact management, and pengurus rekap with diterima/piutang views.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working correctly. AI processing completed in 6-9 seconds per image. Duplicate detection working. Permissions correctly enforced (operator gets 403 on all /api/wa/* endpoints).

minor_issues.issue: Could not verify Pengurus & No. Ref fields in add form during automated test
minor_issues.note: Navigation to form may require different approach. Backend API confirmed these fields exist and work correctly.

additional_notes.ai_processing: Real AI calls using Gemini (gemini-3-flash-preview) via Emergent LLM key. Processing time: 6-9 seconds per image. Only 1 concurrent request allowed (queued correctly).
additional_notes.test_images: Used real test images from /app/tests/fixtures/ - hm.webp (actually BRI transfer receipt) and transfer.png (actually ZOOMLION HM screen). AI correctly identified both despite swapped filenames.
additional_notes.whatsapp_api: WhatsApp Cloud API not configured (expected). Webhook returns 503/disabled. Upload mode working correctly.
additional_notes.cleanup: All test data cleaned up: 4 inbox items, 1 kas_masuk, 1 operation, 1 contact, unit kode_wa reset to original value.
additional_notes.regression: Existing features (finance, reports, units CRUD) still working correctly based on navigation tests.
